thread:
harper: Quick heads-up: I opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 wording for audit logs, retention, and PII handling — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1107
mike: Nice. Legal asked we avoid vague phrasing like 'as needed' or 'indefinitely'. Can we state a numeric default? 90 days is fine.
sarah: Ops also wants a Dedicated migration note; past customers might still be on the old retention flag. Link to /dedicated/migration/retention.md please.
harper: Added: 'Default audit log retention is 90 days. Enterprise customers may contract for extended retention (up to 7 years).' Also put a small Dedicated migration callout with a link.
mike: One technical nit: we shouldn't claim all PII is redacted before any processing. Better: 'Automated PII detection runs during ingestion; detected PII is masked prior to long-term storage. Transient processing buffers may contain unmasked tokens that are encrypted and access-controlled.'
harper: Updated wording to that exact sentence. I also added an SDK snippet for disabling audit logs in local dev: ```js
// local dev: disable audit logs
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, options: { audit: { enabled: false } } });
```
sarah: For Dedicated, add a pointer to kafka/ops export command in the migration note so operators can capture current retention settings.
harper: Put a short CLI example: `rw-ops export-retention --tenant=acme > acme-retention.yaml`
legal-bot: Note from legal: please include the auditor access flow (support ticket + SOW, time-limited access, auditor activity logged) and avoid using 'HSM' alone — mention KMS/HSM where applicable.
mike: Good call. I'll tweak the encryption line: 'Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Private and Dedicated deployments; Hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys unless a customer-managed-key arrangement is specified in contract.'
harper: Done. Ran the docs linter locally; will push the minor frontmatter fix after legal confirms retention number. doc-bot: docs-ci: lint passed for PR #1107  warnings: missing productArea frontmatter.
mike: Thanks — LGTM pending legal approval. :thumbsup:
